options.text: Cosmos Semantic authenticates every API and MCP call. Wire it to your own Microsoft Entra ID tenant, or leave these fields empty to deploy in anonymous/test mode (no login required; use this only to try the product, never for real data).

elements.name: oidcIssuer
elements.label: Microsoft Entra ID issuer URL (optional)
elements.toolTip: Example: https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0. Leave empty for anonymous/test mode.

validations.message: Must be empty, or a URL starting with https://login.microsoftonline.com/

elements.name: oidcAudience
elements.label: Application (client) ID or API audience (optional)
elements.toolTip: The application ID URI or client ID of the Microsoft Entra ID app registration that represents this API. Leave empty for anonymous/test mode.
